problem: The yield-strength constraint does not enforce the required 235 MPa value for normal-strength hull structural steel, including nltl:normalStrengthHullStructuralSteel and the normal-strength grades nltl:steelGradeB, nltl:steelGradeD, and nltl:steelGradeE; any positive value currently passes.
required_change: Add a normal-strength branch rejecting yield values other than 235 MPa, while separately permitting only explicitly represented accepted substitutions if those are supported by the model.
regression_guard: Preserve the existing requirement that high-strength hull structural steel values are at least 315 MPa and retain the canonical steel-grade values.
